summary.text: SPEKTRO AS is a private limited company registered in Steinkjer, founded 2006-01-06. SPEKTRO AS develops, produces and sells personal fall protection equipment and related products used in industrial applications for work at height. Its main industry code is 32.990: other manufacturing n.e.c.. The register shows 5 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 13 068 284 NOK and the annual result was 3 442 423 NOK; operating income was up from 8 167 766 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 1 516 122 NOK in 2024 to 3 442 423 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 4 326 802 NOK in 2024 to 7 769 225 NOK in 2025.
